literature.role: Established gate teleportation, not a novelty claim.

research_decision: Quadratic programs with a common isotropic input yield exact equations in one use; identical copies are unnecessary. Build a charged native program factory with a valid label law, rather than another readout obstruction.

proof_obligations.PO-PROGRAM: One genuinely supplied flat field3 program with public component quadratic functions and common unknown secret. Public classical functions do not grant an unknown phase oracle.
proof_obligations.PO-CHOI: Basis copying produces an entangled Choi program, not two independent copies. Bell output is3^-d U_s X^a Z^-b on arbitrary reference-entangled data. Every Bell outcome has probability3^-2d.
proof_obligations.PO-ISOTROPY: A nonzero direction must annul every component quadratic form before the random Bell shift. Wide construction is polynomial only under its stated width bound; bounded exhaustive controls are not scalable solvers.
proof_obligations.PO-CORRECTION: Shift the known affine output line, unembed it with a public field chart, and remove only the known b*v phase. No unknown Clifford correction or inverse.
proof_obligations.PO-LABEL: Fixed-program uniform labels require full gradient rank. Alternatively fresh independent uniform linear offsets plus a matrix-only isotropic chooser give a source-ensemble uniform law. Do not mix these criteria or grant the offset source premise without proof.
proof_obligations.PO-NATIVE: Native level3 packet restrictions must pass all mixed cubic components and match true original-root phases. Every complement outcome is charged. Engineered low-source calibrations are not an IID native program factory.
proof_obligations.PO-RESOURCE: Charge original ancestry, all source/program measurements and the conditional Bell branch mass. Each program is consumed once. Calibration outcomes are virtual controls, not independently acquired source samples.
proof_obligations.PO-DEPTH: Only a field-root conditional receiver is implemented. Higher-depth phase restrictions, typical factory coverage, full-secret digit recovery and a complexity improvement against known sieves remain open.
proof_obligations.PO-REVIEW: External mathematical review and novelty checking are pending. Gate teleportation is known; no generic no-go, accepted breakthrough algorithm or standard LWE attack.

falsifiable_experiments: An anisotropic line is incorrectly assigned a deterministic Fourier equation.
An actual original frequency table disagrees with the public quadratic family.
A Bell shift/phase branch is omitted, has wrong probability, or needs an unknown correction.
Gradient-deficient fixed programs are called uniform, or beta-dependent directions are assigned the fresh-offset law.
An engineered rare program branch or virtual calibration outcome is counted as a free scalable source factory.
